text:
mira: quick design check small PR for the Credentials list. main goals: make rotate the recommended path, surface impact before destructive actions, and tidy up keyboard flow for modals. figma: https://figma.com/snap/cred-compact. jakob: looks good. one thing: the CTA order in the revoke modal is backwards for keyboard users. cancel should be first in DOM, primary last (even if visually primary is on the right). sam: a11y: agree. also ensure revoke uses role=dialog+aria-modal and that the toast after revoke is announced with role=alert and gives focus to the Undo button. sample:
Key revoked.
anika: copy tweak: revoke body should explicitly warn about services: "This will invalidate the key. Any requests using it will fail." add a short line: "Not sure? Try Rotate first." mira: for bulk revoke, propose thresholds: <=5 normal confirm, >5 typed-confirm "REVOKE", >50 require approval flow. show an approximate impact count when available: "~3 endpoints affected". jakob: visual nit: permission chips are noisy. compact them to "Perms: billing, logs +1" and expand on hover/focus. keeps rows scannable. sam: test cases: dialog traps focus, toast announced and Undo focused, focus returns to table header or next row after removal, typed-confirm only triggered by count threshold. I'll add to a11y checklist. anika: action: i'll update mocks with CTA/dom order fix, typed-confirm thresholds, compact perms, and toast behavior. will post updated frames in 30m. infra-bot: design review logged by mira, reviewers: jakob, sam.
